faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.q: How safe is my financial data?
items.a: We use bank-level 256-bit SSL encryption and are SOC 2 compliant. Your data is encrypted both in transit and at rest, and we never sell your information.

items.q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
items.a: Absolutely. You can cancel your plan at any moment from your account settings — no questions asked, and no hidden fees.

items.q: How is ProfitPlanner different from my banking app?
items.a: Banking apps only show one account. ProfitPlanner aggregates all your accounts, investments, and goals into one unified dashboard with smart insights.

items.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
items.a: No. Our Free plan requires no credit card and gives you full access to the core dashboard forever.

items.q: Will there be a mobile app?
items.a: Yes — native iOS and Android apps are part of our 2025 roadmap. The web app is fully responsive in the meantime.

items.q: Will SME and ERP features be included in my plan?
items.a: The upcoming SME Business Planner will be available as a separate Business tier. Existing Pro users will get exclusive launch pricing.
